items.why: The report identifies "A1' at 240.8 cm-1" as a first-order monolayer mode with fitted centre 240.1–241.3 cm-1, although it treats E' as equally dominant.

The report says the 531 and 582–586 cm-1 bands "resonate in the same 2.0–2.1 eV window" and that the 432/457 cm-1 bands instead peak near the A exciton, but it never says the 480/531/583 cm-1 peaks are absent at A1s or specific to 2s.
It places the resonance at ~2.04–2.05 eV and suggests "B 2s or a higher state" without committing, and says incoming and outgoing resonances "cannot be distinguished" rather than identifying them.
It assigns "531 = A1'+E'", "481 ≈ 2A1'" and 582 cm-1 as near 2E' (Gamma-phonon combinations), but gives no intravalley Rydberg-exciton scattering interpretation.
It places the A exciton at "~1.64–1.65 eV" and states the A1' area is "~490–580 vs ~2 at 2.1 eV, i.e. >250x stronger", which is roughly two orders of magnitude.
It notes "negative excursions, so luminescence subtraction is imperfect" at 1.6479 eV and a "broad residual background" at 2.000 eV, and discusses depolarized E' cancelling in parallel minus crossed.

It states "Assignments of the 432, 457, 481, 531, 582-586 and 600 cm-1 bands are tentative (first-order modes, overtones, or two-phonon combinations involving M-point phonons)" and also questions the E' assignment.
It asks for "a reflectance or PL excitation spectrum of this same flake" and notes that only 9 laser points constrain the resonance centre and width.

wrong_claims.why: The report assigns these peaks to MoSe2 phonon combinations, not to the Si or hBN substrate.
The report does not claim the 480/531/583 cm-1 peaks are equally present at A1s; it calls those fits unreliable at 1.65–1.68 eV.
